hazards.description: Actual hazards / risks only (not controls, not prose mentioning "risk")

method_steps.description: The ordered construction method — the sequence of actions the crew performs

sequence_notes.description: One-to-three sentence summary of overall sequencing / staging

source_path.description: Storage locator of the source document the record was extracted from

title.description: The document's title / works name; also the record-identity fallback when the basename is absent

work_activity.description: Short phrase naming the primary activity (e.g. a foundations or slope-stabilisation activity)
